title.zh: 谷歌给Genie 4配上Gemini「导演」：一边生成世界，一边规划剧情
title.en: 谷歌给Genie 4配上Gemini「导演」：一边生成世界，一边规划剧情

current_state.zh: Google DeepMind unveiled Genie 4, a world model that generates explorable, controllable 3D environments from text with native environmental audio, music and real-time character dialogue, paired with Gemini 3.8 Flash as a real-time planning 'director' and Gemini Omni for visual realism, initially available only to a small group of testers ahead of Google AI Ultra, Gemini API and AI Studio availability.
current_state.en: Google DeepMind unveiled Genie 4, a world model that generates explorable, controllable 3D environments from text with native environmental audio, music and real-time character dialogue, paired with Gemini 3.8 Flash as a real-time planning 'director' and Gemini Omni for visual realism, initially available only to a small group of testers ahead of Google AI Ultra, Gemini API and AI Studio availability.
